purpose: Test one coefficient-free post-selection queue-externality veto on V117: preserve its candidate enumeration and ranking bit-for-bit, then retain the exact anchor only when the first otherwise accepted substitution has greater admitted-work processor-sharing interference than that anchor.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.strongest_parent: V117 remains the strongest prior mechanism: spike and sustained passed throughput and both QPR gates; pulse passed throughput and positive mean QPR but failed the two-of-three QPR direction rule.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v133_outcome: V133 passed none of nine frozen gates. Spike throughput/QPR changed -0.326/-0.416 percent, sustained -0.465/-0.665 percent, and pulse +0.923/+5.459 percent; pulse nevertheless had only one of three favorable paired directions for throughput and QPR.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.v133_mechanism_falsification: V133's enumeration-stage filter was active but too invasive: across 1,811 active windows it rejected 1,310 candidate nodes before the unchanged V117 ranking and produced 61 componentwise-rejected windows, with no unavailable inputs. The complete V133 cohort is retained and no confirmation input was opened.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Remove V133's enumeration-stage filtering. Preserve V117 enumeration, service ordering, locality, headroom, downstream, and complete componentwise service bit-for-bit; compare interference only for the first otherwise accepted V117 substitution and veto that substitution to the exact anchor when locally worse. No second-best search, scenario label, result-derived coefficient, threshold, ratio, horizon, weight, cap, or smoothing width is added.

closed_axes.admitted_work_definition: pending plus all resident remaining plus same-window projected immutable CPU remains bit-for-bit V117
closed_axes.selected_choice_interference_veto: the sole enabled V134 axis; the same coefficient-free V114 proxy is evaluated only for V117's first otherwise accepted substitution
closed_axes.completion_proximal_and_terminal_child_a: V123-V131 are failed training branches and are not combined with V134

hypothesis.primary: V133 may have failed because filtering every enumerated alternative changed V117's ranked choice set and promoted second-best routes. The local externality hypothesis can instead be tested without reranking: veto only the first substitution that unchanged V117 would otherwise accept.
hypothesis.candidate: Run the complete V117 choice path first. For its first service-, score-, locality-, resource-, downstream-, and feasibility-safe alternative, compute the V114 admitted-interference proxy for that selected node and the exact anchor from the same prefix. Accept only when finite and selected interference is no greater; otherwise immediately preserve the anchor without considering another alternative. Then apply every unchanged V117 complete-assignment certificate.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass every paired throughput and both QPR gates in all three E3 scenarios on the complete fresh E1425-E1427 cohort.

allowed: all immutable and current-state V117 admitted-work, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and critical-frontier inputs
the exact per-player V117 anchor node, service-qualified alternative node, prefix assignment, and native player order available before dispatch
pending immutable CPU values, every resident task's finite nonnegative remaining CPU, earlier same-window projected immutable CPU, current-player immutable CPU, and node capacity
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
any result-derived threshold, margin, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, or smoothing width
formal E01-E20 outcome-dependent selection or confirmation outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.componentwise_interference_definition: Bit-for-bit V114 admitted interference for the current player: sum min(x,current_player_work)/node_capacity over every pending immutable CPU value, every resident remaining CPU value, and every earlier same-window projected immutable CPU value in the current prefix.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any unavailable work value, count mismatch, invalid capacity, nonfinite arithmetic, incomplete assignment, replay infeasibility, componentwise coverage mismatch, or failed frozen V117 certificate preserves the exact anchor choice or assignment.

arms.complete_componentwise_service_rule: every current critical-frontier player's alternative admitted-work service proxy is no greater than its anchor proxy
arms.selected_choice_interference_veto_rule: the first otherwise accepted V117 substitution has no greater admitted interference than that player's exact anchor choice; otherwise preserve anchor without second-best search

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Enable one coefficient-free admitted-interference veto after V117 identifies its first otherwise accepted substitution; V117 enumeration and ranking remain unchanged and a veto preserves the exact anchor without second-best search.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without finite selected-choice and anchor interference inputs, a complete finite componentwise service certificate, and every frozen V117 gate, preserve the exact anchor or assignment.

per_window: all frozen V117 causal-arrival, admitted-work, critical-service, componentwise-service, score, welfare, assignment-hash, and feasibility fields
selected-choice admitted-interference veto enabled, anchor and selected proxy, unavailable count, vetoed substitution count, and accepted selected-choice count
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V134 profile
